title: The Movie 'Niu Lai' Makes a Shocking Comeback: Box Office Revenue Rises from 3,420 Yuan to 4.19 Million, with Investors and Young People Jointly Making a Crappy Film a Phenomenon

content_html:
A Chinese animated film that only earned 7,711 yuan in box office after ten days of release suddenly topped 72 Weibo hot search topics on August 15, with its daily box office reaching 717,000 yuan, and the next day approaching 4.19 million yuan. The film's title "Niu Lai" sounds like "Niu Shi Yao Lai" (the stock market is coming), which immediately made more than 200 million A-share investors identify with this "poorly made" movie.

Investors seek luck, a collective performance art

The production company, Dalian Jingyuan, was originally a decoration company with a registered capital of only 100,000 yuan, and the entire crew consisted of only a mother and daughter. Director Xinyu Meng is not a professional, and she single-handedly handled writing, directing, editing, and voice acting. With just a home computer, she and her mother spent five years "hand-crafting" the film without outsourcing or capital investment. This crude modeling and frequent model glitches became a spiritual comfort for investors who saw it as a sign of "bull market coming," with investors booking entire screenings, sharing tickets as if they were "new share subscription results," and even South Korean investors worshiped it as the "ancestral god of semiconductors" due to the homophonic meaning of "stumbling" and "semiconductors."

The more absurd part is that the louder the criticism, the higher the box office. Audiences criticized the film while filming and uploading it online, turning watching into a collaborative performance art. Cinemas added more showtimes and even scheduled them in Dolby theaters. Caixin commented that audiences had grown tired of formulaic mediocrity. "Niu Lai" was raw and lacked industrial packaging, becoming a rare "authenticity." People laughed at the bad movie but cheered for an uprising against mediocrity.

The more AI can generate, the more "hand-crafted" becomes precious

In 2026, where AI video generation has reached the point of being indistinguishable from reality, AI faces and AI voices have already caused public disgust. A mother and daughter who did not use AI, creating each frame manually, showed a rare sense of originality and courage. Viewers said that the bull determined to go straight ahead was the self in everyone's heart who holds onto their principles.

Their popularity is essentially an emotional release using the film as a tool, with limited content concentration and difficult to replicate. But when a group of people surrounded by the market, formulas, and AI collectively entered the cinema to cheer for a stubborn, unyielding cow, they found long-lost relaxation and resonance.

content_html_zh:
一部上映十天票房仅7711元的中国动画电影，8月15日突然登上72个微博热搜话题，日票房达到71.7万元，第二天就逼近419万元。 影片的片名《牛来》听起来像“牛市要来”（股市来了），立刻让两亿多A股投资者认同了这部“制作拙劣”的电影。

投资者求运气，集体行为艺术

制作公司大连晶源原本是一家装修公司，注册资金只有10万元，整个剧组只有母女俩。 导演孟新宇并非专业人士，编剧、导演、剪辑、配音都是她一手包办。 她和母亲只用一台家用电脑，在没有外包或资本投资的情况下，花了五年时间“手工制作”这部电影。 这种粗糙的建模和频繁的模型故障成为投资者的精神安慰，他们将其视为“牛市即将到来”的征兆，投资者全场预订，分享门票，仿佛这是“新股认购结果”，甚至韩国投资者因“绊倒”和“半导体”的谐音而将其崇拜为“半导体祖神”。

更荒唐的是，批评声越大，票房就越高。 观众在拍摄并上传到网上时批评这部电影，将观看变成了一种协作的行为艺术。 电影院增加了放映时间，甚至安排在杜比影院放映。 财新评论称，观众已经厌倦了公式化的平庸。 “牛来”未经加工，缺乏工业包装，成为难得的“正宗”。 人们嘲笑这部糟糕的电影，却为反抗平庸的起义欢呼。

AI能生成的越多，“手工”就越珍贵

2026年，AI视频生成已经到了与现实无法区分的地步，AI面孔、AI声音已经引起公众的厌恶。 一对母女没有使用人工智能，每一帧都是手工创作，表现出了罕见的原创感和勇气。 观众表示，一头决志一往无前的牛，是每个人心中坚守原则的自己。

它们的走红本质上是一种以电影为工具的情感释放，内容集中度有限，难以复制。 但当一群被市场、公式、人工智能包围的人集体走进电影院，为一头顽强不屈的牛加油时，他们找到了久违的放松和共鸣。
